subject: Kickoff: ALX — large-scale matrix factorization on TPUs
body:
Hi Bruno, team,

Kicking off ALX. It's a JAX library for distributed matrix factorization with Alternating Least Squares, designed around the TPU architecture — it scales to problems with billions of rows/columns by scaling the number of TPU cores.

Why we care: our internal recommendation surfaces still run a factorization job that takes eleven hours and can't grow. If ALX gives us the same Recall@20 in a fraction of the time, that's a straight infrastructure win we can bank this half.

Milestones: single-pod training loop with checkpoint/restore by mid-April, scaling study across core counts in May, Recall@20 and Recall@50 comparison against the incumbent by end of May, decision June 1.

Priya
